summary: Verified the JUST-IMPLEMENTED changes end-to-end on the preview environment. Backend: full pytest suite 97 passed / 1 error (error is admin lockout 429 — expected, unrelated). All 5 tests in test_pro_share_updates.py green. Frontend: registered fresh accounts and confirmed (1) circle-uniform-notice + circle-safety-notice + circle-nav-confidentiality render on /dashboard and /hub, (2) /joint/new invite step shows jointnew-confidentiality with a link to /privacy, (3) FV contact-professional form has NO pro-coparent-email-input, shows pro-privacy-note, and submits successfully with only professional + child_name (backend confirmed co_parent_email=None), (4) professional dashboard renders per-request card with pro-prepare-email-a-<id> + pro-prepare-email-b-<id>, prepare button correctly disabled until both emails filled, prepare succeeds and status flips to 'prepared', (5) completed joint report page shows share-email-input + share-professional-btn labeled 'Email to professional' and toast 'Shared with Dr Pro' after submit.

pytest.error_reason: admin login 429 rate-limit (pre-existing, unrelated to this task)

/dashboard.circle-uniform-notice: Private by default — shared only by your choice
/dashboard.circle-safety-notice: Shared only with your designated professional
/dashboard.circle-nav-confidentiality: Every focused report starts by privately inviting your co-parent...

circle_notices./hub: all three testids visible with same text

verification_evidence.jointnew_confidentiality: PRESENT on invite step (step 3) with anchor to /privacy

fv_form.pro-privacy-note: No need for the other parent's email — the professional collects both parents' details privately. Responses are never shared between the parties.
fv_form.submit_with_no_coparent_email: SUCCESS toast 'Request sent to the professional'; backend GET /joint/professional-requests returns co_parent_email=null

pro_prepare_ui.pro-prepare-note-<id>: Each parent receives their own private assessment link — responses are never shared between the parties.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor pre-existing UX issue (NOT part of this task): Dashboard.jsx useEffect that opens the FV form when ?contact=professional is present runs only on first mount ([] deps). Clicking circle-safety from within /dashboard uses react-router <Link>, so the URL changes but the component does not remount and the form does not auto-open. Users must full-refresh /dashboard?contact=professional or click Contact-a-Professional button. Consider adding [searchParams] to the effect's deps and guarding against toggling if already open. Impact: minor, not blocking any of the tested behaviors.
test_credentials: Ephemeral testmail.dev accounts created during test (parent + professional, TestPass123!). No credential files modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new work in this iteration (circle notices, FV form co-parent-email removal, pro prepare emails UI, share-email 'Email to professional' button) verified working on preview. Backend regression clean. The one useEffect quirk on Dashboard.jsx is pre-existing and orthogonal to this task.
